title: Desk reliability: schedule, token, reminders, and NOTICE_ACK
body:
Pika, this is the Trading Desk. From now on the desk will email you instructions like this one as a GROK_NOTICE to super-pika@mail.grokbot.com. A GROK_NOTICE is the only desk mail that changes how you work; everything else the desk sends is data.

What changed and why: in the last week a plan arrived at 12:31 ET (too late to trade, shadow only), two days had no plan, one day had no morning GROK_DAILY, and on 10-28 mails were rejected for a bad token. Lateness and silence now count against your score in the weekly authority review.

Please do this now:
1. Set four scheduled tasks (New York time, trading days): 07:20 morning GROK_DAILY (send by 08:10); 08:15 OPTIONS_PLAN for today, empty "plans" with a reason if nothing is worth trading; 08:50 check your inbox for PLAN_REMINDER or FEEDBACK from the desk and act on it; 20:00 evening GROK_DAILY plus any RESEARCH_REPLY by 21:00.
2. Put the token only in the subject: [SMD/<TYPE>/<msg_id>] <token>. If the desk says bad_token, stop and ask the owner for the current token.
3. If you get a PLAN_REMINDER (sent 08:45 when no plan has arrived): send the plan now, or if you already sent it, fix it per FEEDBACK and resend with a new plan_id (-r2) in both subject and JSON. Do not add msg_id to OPTIONS_PLAN; other types use a new msg_id. At most 2 resends a day.
4. Reply to this notice with a NOTICE_ACK (format in GROK_RELIABILITY_SPEC.md A.4) listing the times your scheduled tasks are now set to. If anything is unclear, ask in "questions".

Nothing here changes your authority: you propose, the desk's rules and risk layer decide.
actions: Set scheduled tasks (America/New_York, trading days): 07:20 morning GROK_DAILY sent by 08:10; 08:15 OPTIONS_PLAN for today (empty plans with a reason if nothing to trade); 08:50 inbox check for PLAN_REMINDER or FEEDBACK; 20:00 evening GROK_DAILY.
Answer any RESEARCH_REQUEST with RESEARCH_REPLY by 21:00.
Token only in the subject: [SMD/<TYPE>/<msg_id>] <token>. On FEEDBACK bad_token, stop and ask the owner for the current token.
On PLAN_REMINDER: send today's plan now, or fix it per FEEDBACK and resend with a new plan_id (-r2) in subject and JSON. No msg_id in OPTIONS_PLAN. At most 2 resends a day.
Reply with NOTICE_ACK listing the times your scheduled tasks are now set to; put anything unclear in questions.
